RIGHT knee passes forward airborne. Later than early stance but before rear push. Keep leg identity and NW boot axes.

Anatomical LEFT hand holds upper qin and RIGHT lower strings, never swap. Do not resize/translate/recenter the whole sprite. Change only articulated legs/boots and adjacent lower garment as needed; weight comes from knee and ankle articulation. Round short-limbed chibi proportions, no stretched limbs. Preserve NW viewpoint and both leg identities. Boots follow direction, never sideways or increasing outward splay. No floor, shadow, text, labels, sheet, duplicated legs or detached boots. Return 1254x1254 at identical framing and scale, true alpha. Image3 controls detailed lilac/ivory/gold painted material and finish only.
